## The product development system for teams and agents

Purpose-built for planning and building products. Designed for the AI era.

[New Loops →](https://linear.app/now/introducing-loops)

**Loops** are recurring agent workflows that respond to workspace activity — initiatives, projects, cycles — and can edit Linear documents and post updates to Slack.

**Priority Inbox** separates what needs your attention from what can wait, so a review blocking a release never gets buried.

**Coding sessions** let Linear Agent set up, run, and test code in a secure cloud environment before opening a pull request for review.

Linear powers **40,000+** product teams — from ambitious startups to major enterprises.

[Customer stories →](/customers)

[Get started](/signup) · [Contact sales](/contact/sales) · [Open app](/login) · [Download](/download)

## A new species of product tool

Purpose-built for modern teams with AI workflows at its core, Linear sets a new standard for planning and building products.

### Purpose-built
Shaped by the practices and principles of world-class product teams.

### Powered by agents
Designed for workflows shared by humans and agents — from drafting PRDs to pushing PRs. Linear Agent works in a secure cloud environment to write and test code before opening a pull request for review.

### Designed for speed
Reduces noise and restores momentum to help teams ship with high velocity and focus. Priority Inbox surfaces blocking reviews; Loops automate recurring product management workflows across initiatives, projects, and cycles.

### Faster app launch

Render UI before `vehicle_state` sync completes when minimum required state is present, instead of blocking on full refresh during iOS startup.

#### Activity
Linear created the issue via Slack; Triage Intelligence added **Performance** and **iOS** labels. Team discussion identified the spinner blocking initial render. Linear produced a draft PR changing 2 files — moving the issue from **Todo** to **In Progress**.

#### Code change (HomeScreen.tsx)
```diff
- if (syncStatus === SyncStatus.PENDING) { return <ActivityIndicator size="large" /> }
+ if (!isFullySynced) { return <ActivityIndicator size="large" /> }
+ return <Dashboard state={vehicleState} syncStatus={syncStatus} />
```

The fix returns the dashboard with partial state while sync continues in background. Shipped in **Linear App 1.6881** (Jun 25).
